name: Camping Seespitz Walchsee
beschreibung: Camping Seespitz Walchsee is situated right on Lake Walchsee in the Kufstein district. The resort features spacious pitches for caravans and motorhomes. It boasts its own lido beach with a sunbathing lawn and bathing pier. Guests also enjoy access to a heated outdoor swimming pool. The immediate surroundings offer fantastic opportunities for sailing and windsurfing. The campsite is equally suited for families and nature enthusiasts.
